messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed on api-gateway-eu (edge tier). Error spike started ~5m ago. Auto-pager triggered. Paging on-call.
Alice K: on it, joining now. seeing 502/504 across multiple routes, spikes from 60rps->2k rps failure ratio 18% on /v1/generate
Jason M: I can look at ingress proxies and LB. any regional patterns? eu-west-1 only or global?
Meera P: eu-west + eu-central. apigw telemetry shows fanout to edge-proxies hitting timeouts when backend concurrency increases. probably upstream saturation.
Tom L: Customer impact: several PLG customers hitting higher error rates. UX shows request timeouts then retries. I'll grab recent support tickets.
Samir R: I'm toggling routing fallback to healthy region for critical customers. Holding on changes until we confirm SLO impact. :thinking_face:
Alice K: Quick triage: disable smart-retries at edge to reduce fanout. Can someone push config change to the edge config service? It's a quick kill switch.
Jason M: On it. Pushing feature flag: `edge.smart_retries.enabled=false` to eu clusters. command:
```
curl -X POST https://config.internal/v1/flags -d '{"flag":"edge.smart_retries.enabled","value":false,"scope":"eu"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CFG'
```
PagerDuty: PagerDuty: on-call Samir R acknowledged the page. Estimated ETA 2m.
Meera P: Also increasing connection pool to backends temporarily (k8s svc annotations) to avoid conn exhaustion:
```
kubectl -n apigw patch svc apigw-backend -p '{"spec":{"sessionAffinity":"None"}}'
```
Tom L: Support note: flagged customers: acct-987, acct-123 — priority outreach pending. Logging to #support-alerts.
Samir R: I started a canary route for critical customers to route to eu-central only. Monitoring success rate now.
Alice K: Telemetry: after disabling smart-retries, error rate dropped slightly (from 18% -> 11%) but tail latency climbs on some nodes.
Jason M: Looking at edge proxy logs: seeing a burst of upstream 504 from backend-a pool. Reproduced with a local curl to the same backend - delays of 6-8s then 504.
Meera P: Backend-a pods show high CPU and many GC stalls. Rolling restart one pod now to relieve pressure.
Samir R: Rolling restart in progress. Also throttling low-priority background jobs by setting `BATCH_WORKER_THREADS=2` via feature flags.
Tom L: Customer-impact update: initial tickets were ~5 min ago; impacted users may see 502s on write-heavy endpoints. Logged in the incident dashboard.
Alice K: After rolling restart + retries off, systemwide 5xx is down to 4% and falling. Still watching. :thumbsup:
Jason M: I see a problematic config in the LB healthcheck for backend-a: path `/healthz` returns 200 but p99 response jumps. Switching to TCP healthcheck for now.
Meera P: Switched healthcheck to TCP for backend-a pool. Health stabilized for 2 of 3 nodes.
Samir R: Re-enabling smart-retries would cause spike again. Keep it off. We'll evaluate safe retry logic later.
PagerDuty: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by on-call. Incident severity set to P1. Notifying SRE lead.
Tom L: ETA for full recovery? current plan: keep fallbacks + restart + throttles for 30m, then assess rollback to normal config if stable.
Alice K: Mitigation summary so far: 1) disable edge retries 2) restart backend pods 3) switch LB healthchecks to TCP 4) throttle background jobs 5) route critical customers to eu-central fallback. All applied.
Jason M: Telemetry graph: error rate trending down steadily. I'll keep tracing on for top 10 failed traces and dump flamegraphs for backend-a.
Meera P: Dev note: need postmortem on runaway batch jobs causing backend pressure. I'll create an initial timeline.
Samir R: Handoff soon: I'm out in 10. Alice will take primary for next 30m then hand to Jason for midnight check.
Alice K: Acknowledged. I'll own the active watch. Please add any lingering tasks to the incident runbook.
Tom L: Customer comms: sending an acknowledgement to impacted customers with ETA ~30m. Draft in #support-alerts, pls review.
PagerDuty: PagerDuty: on-call rotation change: Samir R -> Alice K in 12m. Reminder set.
Alice K: Current status: degraded -> partial mitigation deployed. Final check in 20m then start a slow rollback to normal traffic if stable. Logging end-of-incident notes in Postmortem board.
Meera P: Adding a quick checklist for postmortem: root cause hypothesis (background worker saturation + retries causing fanout), mitigation timeline, follow-ups (retry logic safe guards, healthcheck tuning, autoscale thresholds), RCA owner: Meera P.
Tom L: Thanks all. :heart: Closing stream if nothing else.
Samir R: one more: flagged a bug to prevent concurrent safe-retry flips during high error windows — assigned to Jason.
Alice K: No new errors for 6m, moving to monitoring only. I'll close the channel after the 30m watch if stable. :white_check_mark:
